label: Tutorial: Dashboard
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Dashboard page (endpoint dashboard.dashboard). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: Your own dashboard
steps.text: **Add widget** opens the catalogue: charts (rules per format, activity over time…), lists (latest rules, your favorites…) and counters. The banner above can be hidden; the controls stay.

steps.title: Widgets
steps.text: Drag a widget by its title to move it, by its corner to resize it, and close it with its ×. The layout is saved on your account, on every device.
